opportunities.theorem: For every rectangular PPT map S and Hermitian unitary K, a deterministic trace-completed two-cycle built from S and S adjoint composed with Ad_K has EB cube if and only if S S adjoint Ad_K S is EB.
opportunities.importance: Exposes the actual composition-sensitive obligation that flags cannot solve. The strict finite certificate also certifies an open cube-EB neighborhood around the original fixture.
opportunities.mechanism: Isolate deterministic active Choi corners; discard rank-one flag output branches; relate the two triples by HS adjoint and an involutive unitary conjugation.
opportunities.neighborhood: Every Hermitian perturbation within max-entry 1/20900000 of the certified normalized filtered 10 tensor 6 Choi matrix is separable. This follows from an exact I/100000 reserve and a full-Hermitian local basis decomposition.
opportunities.missing_obligation: To reach the ambitious endpoint one must find an actual nonseparable PPT triple; this criterion does not create one.
compatibility_obligations: Fixed exact filters and positive normalization when applying the numerical radius
opportunities.likely_significance: Scoped proof method and exact route rejection. No universal PPT-cube theorem and no major foundational breakthrough.
